cancel.note: Core cancellation is regression-tested: the transfer engine stops mid-copy and removes its partial stage, a replacement cancelled after the old item is moved aside still finishes so the name is never lost, a local delete cancelled during its preflight keeps the file, GIO copy, move and delete refuse an already-cancelled token, and a listing stops after a batch. GIO cancellation during a copy is not tested, and the native UI has no transfer to cancel yet.

rename.note: Not ported. ox-core has the pieces (location::validate_name, transfer::check_write_tree, Node::move_native) but nothing that composes them like rename_item in desktop/gio_backend.py: name validation, the root and whole-SMB-share refusal, the same-name no-op, the snapshot write guard, then a move that never overwrites. desktop/tests/gio_integration.py test_rename_does_not_overwrite and test_rename_parent_of_backup_is_rejected have no Rust port.

transferConflicts.note: Not ported. No ox-core function answers the paste-conflict query of desktop/winspace.py: 1 to 100,000 item URIs, a destination that must be a folder ("Open a destination folder before pasting.") and the items whose names already exist there. It needs a function and tests, including a dangling symlink as the taken name.

trashSupport.note: Not ported. GioNode::can_trash exists but no test calls it, and it maps every error to false, so a not-mounted share would skip the mount retry that trash_support in desktop/gio_backend.py relies on. It must propagate NOT_MOUNTED and be tested on a local folder, an unsupported location and a not-mounted one.
